title: FinCon: A Synthesized LLM Multi-Agent System with Conceptual Verbal Reinforcement for Enhanced Financial Decision Making

claim.summary: FinCon combines manager–analyst financial evidence synthesis with within-episode CVaR alerts and training-stage conceptual verbal reinforcement of prompts.

modules.name: Manager–analyst information aggregation
modules.scope_reason: The concrete seven analyst roles deliver investment insights to a sole trading manager, including stock selection and risk feedback. The recorded manager-analyst module is task-bound; a generic delegation pattern is an abstraction, not a separate implemented module here.

modules.name: Directional portfolio allocation and CVaR alerts
modules.scope_reason: Buy/sell/hold determines signed portfolio-weight constraints;CVaR alerts adjust investment risk behavior.
evidence_locators: PDF p.3; passage beginning "Portfolio Trading Tasks."

modules.name: PnL-grounded conceptual prompt updates
modules.scope_reason: Across-episode updates compare trading returns and conceptual investment beliefs;reward and update semantics are tied to trading.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "Over-Episode Risk Control:"
